$comment: Batch CE1 (2026-09-04). Kaduse-owned Topic Registry -- distinct from the Source/Evidence Registry (owned in channel-content-os, mcp-server/src/clinical-education/). Answers 'what can we write about', never 'where does the evidence come from'. Stores NO generated post copy -- only the topic identity and eligibility metadata. Every topic below has at least one CANONICAL_ACTIVE or CONDITIONAL_VERIFIED source available for its allowedSourceRoles (verified against the sibling repo's registry as of this batch); none was seeded without a real source.
